name: lumenstick-stick-story
description: Stick Story Animation: long-form 16:9 stick figure story videos (business, tech, history, "what if" stories). Bean-shaped stick figures in detailed flat sets, a new shot every few seconds with slow push-ins, props and labels that tell the story, word-pop title cards, generated music and SFX, two thumbnails and post text. Bring a voiceover, a script or just an idea.
